To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the severity and prognosis of COVID 19 could be predicted by CRP, PTC, IL 6 and ORF1 ab Ct, but not by LYM%, and that LYM% was most sensitive and reliable among all the investigated factors in disease typing and prognosis.

LYM% is the most reliable predictor for the prognosis and disease classification of COVID  19, while CRP, PTC, IL 6 and ORF1 ab Ct are also reliable indicators for disease classification and prognosis.

lymphocyte counts, CRP, IL 6 and viral load were the most sensitive indicators in distinguishing between survivors of COVID 19 and those who did not survive, and in classifying COVID 19 cases into critical, severe and moderate disease types.
